name: Battle Instinct
description: Aggression with nowhere left to go but into the next swing.

name: Iron Skin
description: Enough hits taken that the flinch stopped coming.

name: Hardy Constitution
description: Takes the same hits as everyone else and gets up from more of them.

name: Deep Reserves
description: Holds more magic in reserve than most ever learn how to reach for.

name: Unshaken Resolve
description: A mind trained not to let the dark get the better of it.

name: Sidestep
description: A half-step sideways that's already happened by the time the blow arrives.

name: Leech's Thirst
description: Takes back a mouthful from every wound it deals.

name: Arcane Aptitude
description: Spells take shape before the words are finished.

name: Stubborn Blood
description: Poison, hexes, whatever the dark drips into the wound — sometimes the body just refuses it.

name: Predator's Edge
description: Finds the gap in a guard before the enemy knows it's open.

name: Bulwark Stance
description: Feet set, weight behind the shield. Blows arrive at something already braced for them.

name: Second Wind
description: Past the point where the body should have quit, there turns out to be a little more.

name: Bloodletting
description: Every wound it opens gives a little back.

name: Featherstep Training
description: Footwork most fighters never bother to learn, until it's the only reason they're still standing.

name: Restless Vigor
description: Never quite at rest, even in camp, and first to move whenever anything starts.

name: Deepened Channel
description: The spell leaves with more behind it than the caster meant to give.

name: Wellspring
description: A deeper reserve than the caster remembers building.

name: Fixed Gaze
description: Doesn't blink until the curse has taken.

name: Warded Flesh
description: Old marks under the skin turn curses aside before they settle.

name: Executioner's Instinct
description: Knows exactly where the killing blow lands, and how to recover from delivering it.

name: Thunderous Aura
description: Lightning gathers on its own and strikes something every round, no weapon raised.

name: Vampiric Discipline
description: Drinks deep from every wound it deals.

name: Phantom Reflexes
description: The body moves before the mind's finished deciding to.

name: Battle Scholar
description: Writes down what nearly killed it after every fight, and reads it back before the next.

name: Hexbinder
description: Says the target's name aloud. The curse takes it as an order.

name: Quickened Pulse
description: A pulse that runs a beat ahead of everyone else's, and the body follows it.

name: Bitter Marrow
description: What the enemy tries to put in the blood fails to take more often than it should. Something in the bone won't have it.

name: Thornhide
description: A share of every blow goes back to whoever dealt it, and there's more left in the body to take the next.

name: Reaper's Instinct
description: Every kill closes a little of what the fight opened, and every wound it deals feeds it a little more.

name: Lodestone
description: Every enemy in the room keeps looking at it, and every round something near it takes a hit no one saw thrown.

name: Grandmaster's Focus
description: Waits less between strikes and takes more from every fight.

name: Unerring Will
description: Fear stays outside the hands. Some strikes, and some curses, land because they were never going to miss.

name: Arcane Font
description: Somewhere past the hundredth cast the caster stopped drawing on the magic and became where it comes from. The spells land harder, and the supply barely thins.

name: Sealed Bulwark
description: Plate and ward set into the same frame — blows slow to land, and curses slower to stay.
